PinHeader_1x02_P2.54mm_Vertical.about: 2-pin header, one column. Pin 1 on top.

DIP-8_W7.62mm.about: 8-pin chip. Pins 1-4 down the left side, 5-8 back up the right; the rows are 3 holes apart (7.62mm).

R_Axial_DIN0207_L6.3mm_D2.5mm_P10.16mm_H.about: Quarter-watt resistor lying flat, legs 4 holes apart (10.16mm).

CP_Radial_D5.0mm_P2.50mm.about: Small electrolytic capacitor standing up, 5mm across. Pin 1 is +.

C_Disc_D5.0mm_W2.5mm_P5.00mm.about: Ceramic disc capacitor, legs 2 holes apart (5mm, close enough to 5.08mm).

LED_D5.0mm.about: 5mm LED. Pin 1 is the cathode (K, the flat side), pin 2 the anode (A). DIYLC's first leg is the anode.

PinHeader_1x03_P2.54mm_Vertical.about: 3-pin header, one column. Pin 1 on top.

PinHeader_1x04_P2.54mm_Vertical.about: 4-pin header, one column. Pin 1 on top.

PinHeader_2x03_P2.54mm_Vertical.about: 2x3 header, like an AVR ISP socket. Odd pins down the left, even down the right, 1 and 2 on top.

TerminalBlock_Phoenix_MKDS-1,5-2-5.08_1x.about: 2-way screw terminal (the common blue/green one), legs 2 holes apart (5.08mm) along the middle of a 10x10mm body.

DIP-14_W7.62mm.about: 14-pin chip. Pins 1-7 down the left side, 8-14 back up the right.

DIP-16_W7.62mm.about: 16-pin chip. Pins 1-8 down the left side, 9-16 back up the right.

TO-92_Inline_Wide.about: Small transistor (TO-92), legs bent out to 2.54mm. For a BC547/BC557 pad 1 is C, 2 B, 3 E.

TO-220-3_Vertical.about: Regulator or MOSFET standing up (TO-220), legs along the front row, the tab a hole behind.

D_DO-41_SOD81_P10.16mm_Horizontal.about: Power diode (1N4007) lying flat, legs 4 holes apart. Pad 1 is the cathode (K, the band).

D_DO-35_SOD27_P7.62mm_Horizontal.about: Small signal diode (1N4148) lying flat, legs 3 holes apart. Pad 1 is the cathode (K, the band).

Potentiometer_Bourns_3296W_Vertical.about: Multi-turn trimmer, three legs in a row: 3, 2 (the wiper), 1 from the left, the adjusting screw by pad 1.

Arduino_Nano.about: Arduino Nano on two 15-pin headers, rows 6 holes apart; only the header pins are taken, low parts fit under its board.

Pololu_Breakout-16_15.2x20.3mm.about: Pololu-style 16-pin breakout (motor drivers like the DRV8833 come like this), two 8-pin rows 5 holes apart; only the pins are taken.

Adafruit_Feather.about: Adafruit Feather on a 16-pin and a 12-pin header, rows 8 holes apart; only the pins are taken.

RaspberryPi_Pico_Common_THT.about: Raspberry Pi Pico on two 20-pin headers, rows 7 holes apart; only the pins are taken.

Adafruit_HUZZAH_ESP8266_breakout.about: Adafruit HUZZAH ESP8266 breakout on two 10-pin headers, rows 8 holes apart; only the pins are taken.
